subject: general
question:
The image represents one of the ways through which a batsman can be given “out” in the game of cricket. What is it called?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa6491bbc8349f986a036667f1b529353ab837bb7b9e775ae1332f05ad88372f.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bowled**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The image depicts the batsman’s **stumps being hit by the ball**, which indicates the mode of dismissal known as **Bowled**. ***Hence, option 1 is correct.***
 
• A batsman is declared **Bowled** when:
 
 
• The ball delivered by the bowler hits the **stumps**.
 
• At least one **bail** is dislodged from the wicket.
 
 
 
• In this dismissal, it does not matter whether the ball touches:
 
 
• The bat
 
• The pad
 
• Any part of the batsman’s body
 
 before hitting the stumps, provided no other player touche
